subject.title: fix(infra): use || for empty socket path/token fallback in mergeExecApprovalsSocketDefaults

question: Should exec-approvals setters silently replace malformed blank socket paths or tokens at runtime, or should invalid persisted socket state remain a normalization/Doctor concern?
rationale: The proposed behavior changes recovery for a local socket token used by the exec-approvals security boundary, but no supported caller path currently proves that blank values reach this helper after normalization.

options.title: Keep canonical normalization
options.body: Do not merge this defensive fallback unless a reachable current bug is demonstrated; retain invalid-state handling at the established normalization or Doctor boundary.

options.title: Support runtime recovery
options.body: Confirm blank persisted socket fields are a supported recovery case, then add setter-level before/after proof and targeted coverage for gateway and node-host writes.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical normalization
recommendation.body: Do not merge this defensive fallback unless a reachable current bug is demonstrated; retain invalid-state handling at the established normalization or Doctor boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Historical work connects the gateway and node-host setters to the normalization-and-merge boundary under review.
